Text:
# BACTERIAL MENINGITIS WITH N. MENINGITIDIS

Once a diagnosis of acute bacterial meningitis is considered likely, antimicrobials should be initiated as soon as possible after obtaining blood cultures and performing a lumbar puncture to obtain cerebrospinal fluid.

Meningococcal disease prophylaxis should be given to close contacts. Contact Infectious Diseases/Epidemiology for advice and assistance.

# Consult Infectious Diseases

# Duration of Therapy

Treat for a total duration of 7 days.

---

Therapy:
Preferred:

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h ($) M

Alternative:

Assessment of beta-lactam reaction

Penicillin MIC <0.1 mcg/mL: Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h ($$) R

Penicillin MIC 0.1-1.0 mcg/mL: Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h ($$) R,O
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU BACT MENING N. MENINGITIDIS
